text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh! I can't believe I lost!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I let them catch me and couldn't fight
back. The
gap just got wider and wider...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 今はたくさん悔しがろう！
次はシチーが引き離す番

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This is seriously the worst! That last part
keeps
playing back in my head!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you making fun of me?
choice_data_list: でもいい顔してるぞ、シチー
でもいい顔してるよ、シチー

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 勝利に燃えてる子の顔だ
勝利に燃えてる子の顔だよ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Obviously! I'm not losing ever again!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I don't want anyone passing me again!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave them all in the dust. No one
gets in the
way of my running!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: なら勝てる自分になろう

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Someone's talking big. Are you really
that
confident?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then you'd better take on half the responsibility too. Go ahead and make me a winner!
